I Still Know What You Did Last Summer | I Still Know What You Did Last Summer is a 1998 American slasher film and a sequel to the 1997 film "I Know What You Did Last Summer". Jennifer Love Hewitt, Freddie Prinze, Jr. and Muse Watson reprise their roles, with Brandy, Mekhi Phifer, Jennifer Esposito, and Matthew Settle joining the cast.
